findings: Revised Ego improves MP-referenced wrist disagreement and unknown correction budgets versus legacyEgo, while visible finger-motion failures and heldout image-reference discrepancy remain worse than samecropMP. The result does not establish observer superiority.

Both final native fits have nonzero objective improvements and707changed frames globally; all877 predictions remain present. Unchanged baseline frames are estimates retained by abstention, not missing reconstructed frames.
Pooled selfD2 is lower than legacyEgo and similar toMP with a left/right tradeoff; these are prediction-only diagnostics, not official reference-relative acceleration error.
All native opening proxy curves remain variable. Closer or narrower ranges cannot establish correct true gesture timing, grasp or contact.

SharedMP wrist/depth construction and image admission mean improved proposal placement or generated-target residuals are not independent hand accuracy. Unknown and stride5 orange geometry is unadmitted generated output, not recovered image evidence.
Legacy-versus-revised combines crop routing, retargeting and gating. SamecropMP is the primary controlled pair. The twoMP reference sets also differ and remain fallible.
